india_trends.title: Relief rally in Indian stock market; biggest weekly losing streak in 25 years snapped: What's next for Sensex, Nifty?
india_trends.summary: Indian equities ended the week higher after Friday’s rally helped the Nifty gain 0.44% and the Sensex 0.78%. Financial and IT stocks led the rebound, while easing oil prices offered relief. Analysts cautioned that foreign investor outflows and global risks could limit a sustained recovery.
